# Pixel Art Maker

Pixel art maker: 8-bit, 16-bit and isometric pixel art, game sprites, items and retro scenes generated from your description.

## What it does
Describe what to draw and the pixel style. Claude tells you the price and creates the art.

**How the files are made:** each pixel art image is generated by an image model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Image files; for game use, check the grid and palette before slicing sprites.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install pixel-art-maker@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Pixel Art Maker talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/pixel-art/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each pixel art image uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The pixel art images show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_pixel_art_models` | Models for pixel art images with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_pixel_art_cost` | Exact price of one pixel art image before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_pixel_art` | Starts one pixel art image in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_pixel_art` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A 16-bit knight with a glowing sword"
- "An isometric cozy cabin at night"
- "8-bit potion icons in five colors"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the pixel art image (the subject and the pixel style) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
- Terms of service: https://megascenes.com/legal/terms
- Documentation: https://megascenes.com/connectors#claude
- Support: https://megascenes.com/support
